## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12886 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T13:22Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `7e7a0b6`, against the card's Target and Acceptance, the triage note (`6231969830`) and the claim (`6233627991`, amended in place for two sibling pins).

- **Shape:** the body says `Fixes #12866`; the second line is `Clause-②: no`. The changeset is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **The change:**
  - **One derivation.** `createBody.ts` exports `seedStructuralDefaults(seed)`: the seed minus objectui#12810's `seedPlaceholderKeys`. `buildCreateModeBody` now takes its base from it, with the same keys removed and the same `createDefaults` fallback, so the save body is behaviourally unchanged (the 12810 `createBody` pins pass).
  - **On arrival, once.** A1, measured: the seed rides the `/meta/types` entry, which `useMetadataTypes` fills in an effect after the draft's first render. So one create-mode effect folds the structural defaults into the draft when the seed arrives, once. It adds only keys the draft does not hold (an author edit made first wins), skips `createBuildBody` types, and copies the values so the designer never patches the registry entry's own arrays.
  - A new dataset's Measures reads 1 (`count`) before the first save, and the save writes the same measure. The seed's placeholder identity (`label`, the placeholder object) stays out of the draft as it stays out of the body.
- **Pins:** `ResourceEditPage.createDraftSeed-12866`, through the real `MetadataResourceEditPage`. (a) A seed served at mount, and a seed arriving after the first render, both read Measures 1 with saved measures equal to the seed's. (b) CONTROL: no seed label and no placeholder object in the draft. (c) An author measure added before arrival is not overwritten. **Ablation:** dropping the seeding turns (a) and (b) red; making it overwrite held keys turns (c) red; both restores were proven by blob hash. The whole `metadata-admin` directory (544 files, 6130 tests) is green; `app-shell` type-check exits 0.
- **Sibling pins moved (claim amended):** objectui#12810's and #12848's page pins each read "the first Name textbox", because the seeded `count` row now renders a Name of its own. No assertion changed.
- **Acceptance notes, not filed:**
  - Create drafts for other seeded types now show seed text the save already wrote: object `pluralLabel` "New Objects", agent role and instructions, email subject and body, tool description, a mapping's sample row. Showing it is the point of this card (before-save equals the save), and an author can now see and edit it. Whether any of it is placeholder identity belongs to objectui#12810's family, if a reader appears.
  - The header comment of `ResourceEditPage.seedPlaceholder-12810.test.tsx` still says the object picker resets measures on the first change, which has been stale since objectui#12848.
- **Trailers:** every commit carries only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 36 runs), including Bundle Analysis. Not governed (path audit); 262 changed lines.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

What landed:

- The seed's placeholder identity stays out of the draft, as it stays out of the body (one derivation, `seedStructuralDefaults`).
- Nothing the author set first is overwritten.
- Released as `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
